{{< include /_includes/_data.qmd >}}

```{r}
d |> 
  distinct(country, brand, platform) |> 
  count(country, platform) |> 
  spread(platform, n, fill = 0) |> 
  mutate(c2 = country |> tolower() |> str_replace(" ", "_"),
         country = glue::glue("<a href = '/countries/{c2}.html'>{country}</a>")) |> 
  select(Country = country, everything(), -c2)
```
